actor_github_login_check.name: actor_github_login_check
actor_github_login_check.value: "github_login" is null or ("kind" = 'human' and length("github_login") between 1 and 39 and "github_login" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*' and "github_login" not glob '-*' and "github_login" not glob '*-' and "github_login" not glob '*--*')

api_key_actions_check.name: api_key_actions_check
api_key_actions_check.value: "actions" is null or case when not json_valid("actions") then 0 when json_type("actions") <> 'array' then 0 else json_array_length("actions") between 1 and 5 and (json_array_length("actions") <= 0 or ifnull(json_extract("actions", '$[0]'), '') in ('read', 'issues', 'comments', 'status_updates', 'admin')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 1 or ifnull(json_extract("actions", '$[1]'), '') in ('read', 'issues', 'comments', 'status_updates', 'admin')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 2 or ifnull(json_extract("actions", '$[2]'), '') in ('read', 'issues', 'comments', 'status_updates', 'admin')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 3 or ifnull(json_extract("actions", '$[3]'), '') in ('read', 'issues', 'comments', 'status_updates', 'admin')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 4 or ifnull(json_extract("actions", '$[4]'), '') in ('read', 'issues', 'comments', 'status_updates', 'admin')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 1 or json_extract("actions", '$[0]') <> json_extract("actions", '$[1]')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 2 or json_extract("actions", '$[0]') <> json_extract("actions", '$[2]')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 3 or json_extract("actions", '$[0]') <> json_extract("actions", '$[3]')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 4 or json_extract("actions", '$[0]') <> json_extract("actions", '$[4]')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 2 or json_extract("actions", '$[1]') <> json_extract("actions", '$[2]')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 3 or json_extract("actions", '$[1]') <> json_extract("actions", '$[3]')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 4 or json_extract("actions", '$[1]') <> json_extract("actions", '$[4]')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 3 or json_extract("actions", '$[2]') <> json_extract("actions", '$[3]')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 4 or json_extract("actions", '$[2]') <> json_extract("actions", '$[4]')) and (json_array_length("actions") <= 4 or json_extract("actions", '$[3]') <> json_extract("actions", '$[4]')) end

invite_username_check.name: invite_username_check
invite_username_check.value: length("username") between 1 and 39 and "username" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*' and "username" not glob '-*' and "username" not glob '*-' and "username" not glob '*--*'

project_key_check.name: project_key_check
project_key_check.value: length("key") between 2 and 10 and "key" not glob '*[^A-Z0-9]*'
